_meanings:
²1 To go to, approach; attain, reach (<ab>fig.</ab> also), arrive at, visit; {#SaSinamupagateyaM#}
 {#kOmudI meGamuktam#} <ls>R. 6. 85</ls>; so {#dEvAdupagataM tfRam#} <ls>Pt. 4</ls>; {#padamupagatA#}
 <ls>Bh. 2. 10</ls>; <ls>Bk. 1. 1</ls>; {#tadupagatam#} <ls>Mu. 5</ls> duly received.
.²2 To enter into, penetrate; {#avalambya jAlakamuKopagatAnudatizWadindukiraRAnmadanaH#} <ls>Śi. 9. 39</ls>.
.²3 To undergo, suffer; {#tamo GoramupAgatam#} <ls>Rām.</ls>
.²4 To go to the state of, attain, acquire; {#tAnapradAyitvamivopagantum#}
 <ls>Ku. 1. 8</ls>; {#pratikUlatAmupagate hi viDO#} <ls>Śi. 9. 6</ls>; so {#nidrAvaSam#},
 {#harzam, tfptim, SAntim, vizAdam#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²5 To approach a woman (for sexual intercourse); {#suptAM mattAM pramattAM#}
 {#vA raho yatropagacCati#} <ls>Ms. 3. 34</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 40</ls>.
.²6 To come upon, attack.
.²7 To occur, happen, present itself; {#kasyAtyantaM suKamupagatam#} <ls>Me. 109</ls>, <ab>v. l.</ab>
.²8 To undertake, begin.
.²9 To suffer, share in.
.²10 To admit, agree to, consent, allow; {#vedAntopagataM Palam#} <ls>Ms. 2. 160</ls>.
.²11 To worship; {#sahapatnyA viSAlAkzyA nArAyaRamupAgamat#} <ls>Rām. 2. 6. 1</ls>.
To cause to come near or approach.
